summary: @servicetitan/schema-comparison preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`), extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it 0755, then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')])` against a shipped 727 KB single-line obfuscated bundle. `math_init.js` uses obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (`WV8StW` shift routine, `n7gIxM` decoding table, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, hex-mangled identifiers) and has no corresponding source in `src/`. Running package code via a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime evades Node-based tooling and executes opaque code with the installer's privileges on `npm install`. The advertised purpose (a small TypeScript schema-diff CLI) has no legitimate need for Bun or for a 727 KB obfuscated bundle. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope with `publishConfig.access: restricted`, consistent with dependency-confusion impersonation of a private internal scope belonging to ServiceTitan.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
